newsitem.title: RWANDA: Rwanda aid workers killed by mine blast.
newsitem.headline: Rwanda aid workers killed by mine blast.

text.p: Three aid workers were killed and 34 injured, many of them seriously, when an anti-tank mine wrecked a bus carrying them to a camp for Rwandan refugees in eastern Zaire on Saturday, aid workers reported in Kigali.

The bus, of the U.N. Refugee agency, was destroyed soon after leaving Goma airport, close to the Rwandan border north of Lake Kivu. It was travelling to Kibumba, a large camp for Rwandan refugees, 10 km (six miles) from Goma.
U.N. officials said the casualties included Red Cross medical staff working in the Kibumba camp and that most of the bus's passengers were Rwandans and Zaireans.
